note: Local models: the revision is the commit the local Hugging Face cache resolves to; it is the one the October 2026 de-identification and order-test runs recorded and loaded. The February 2026 local audit runs and the August 2026 companion and retriever runs recorded no revision or library versions; those settings cannot be recovered (results/run_records.json gives per-run records and the circumstantial evidence). GPU-scored models: revision, precision and torch come from each raw file's self_hosted meta; the other library versions are recorded there for two models and are the stated pod pins for the rest (see runtime_source). `precision` is the dtype the weights actually ran in: transformers 5.x loads with dtype='auto' when no dtype is given.

scoring.device: Apple MPS (Metal) where available, else CPU
scoring.note: max_length=512 is set by the October de-identification runs; the February local audit runs (run_experiment.py) set none and truncated at the tokenizer limit (no pair comes close)
